title: AVP- Business Finance
sourceText: About the CompanyUrban Company is a technology platform offering customers a variety of services at home. Customers use our platform to book services such as beauty treatments, haircuts, massage therapy, cleaning, plumbing, carpentry, appliance repair, painting, etc., all delivered in the comfort of their home and at a time of their choosing. We promise our customers a high-quality, standardized, and reliable service experience. To fulfill this promise, we work closely with our hand-picked service partners, enabling them with technology, training, products, tools, financing, insurance, and brand, helping them succeed and deliver on this promise.Urban Company started as UrbanClap in November 2014, when its founders, Abhiraj, Raghav, and Varun, realized that the home services industry was predominantly unorganized, fragmented, and offline. Customers found it challenging to avail quality services conveniently, and service professionals were struggling to make ends meet, having to rely upon several middlemen, contractors, and local aggregators. The founders felt that the industry was ripe for disruption, and launched Urban Company, with three key principles in mind —Customer love: Build a platform that offers truly delightful and differentiated servicesPartner empowerment: Build a deep, full-stack partnership with service partners, helping improve their earnings and overall livelihoodTechnology first: Bring innovation and technology to an age-old industryWhy This Role ExistsIndia Consumer Services is Urban Company's largest and a fast-scaling business (~INR 4,000 Cr NTV Business) — spanning multiple service categories, a growing set of cities, and a two-sided marketplace of customers and service partnersAs the business scales, it needs someone who can own financial planning, contribution-margin and unit-economics analysis, and deep business partnering across category and city teamsWhat You Will OwnFinancial Planning & ReportingOwn a Large Vertical within India Consumer Services P&L — Net GMV, net revenue (take rate), contribution margin, and Adjusted EBITDA — on a monthly and quarterly basisBuild and maintain the rolling forecast model, tracking actuals vs. plan across categories, cities, and customer cohortsPrepare management packs for the business; own the narrative on performance driversContribution Margin & Unit EconomicsRun structured contribution-margin variance analysis — isolating take-rate movement, category mix, city mix, pricing, and partner-payout changes — and drive the overall margin improvement frameworkModel unit economics at the category × city level (GMV per order, take rate, partner payout, CAC, frequency, and repeat behavior); flag margin-dilutive decisions before they hit the P&LTrack the economics of customer acquisition and retention — CAC, payback, cohort GMV, and lifetime contribution — as the customer base growsPartner & Supply EconomicsWork closely with the supply/category teams on partner earnings, payout structures, and incentive spends, and their impact on contribution marginMonitor supply health and utilization economics — cost-to-serve, partner earnings per hour, and the trade-offs between fill rate, pricing, and partner payouts — and flag risks early to leadershipTrack and model the cost of supply-side programs (onboarding, training, product/tools, financing, insurance) as scale benefits accrueBusiness Partnering & GTM FinancePartner with category and city teams to evaluate market-level economics and prioritize investment — which categories and cities to lean into and where to protect marginEvaluate pricing, take-rate, and incentive decisions on a financial basis: contribution margins, break-even volumes, and elasticity/cannibalization effectsSupport new category and new-city expansion, and adjacent offerings, with financial modelling and go/no-go frameworksWhat We Are Looking ForMust-Have6–10 years of experience in business finance, FP&A, or commercial finance — ideally in a consumer internet, marketplace, services, or high-growth D2C/e-commerce businessStrong P&L ownership mindset — you should be as comfortable owning the moving pieces of a P&L as reporting on themFluency with unit economics and margin analysis in a two-sided or multi-category business — understanding how mix shifts (category, city, cohort) hit both the numerator and denominator of margin %High proficiency in Excel / Google Sheets; ability to build clean, formula-driven models without relying on manual overridesAbility to work directly with business leaders — translating financial analysis into decisions, not just reporting numbersComfort with ambiguity; India Consumer Services is scaling fast and the finance function continues to evolve alongside itStrong Plus — Marketplace / Consumer Finance BackgroundPrior experience in a marketplace, platform, or consumer-services business — working with category or city teams, managing marketing/incentive spends, and evaluating customer and supply-side economics — will be weighted heavilyUnderstanding of how GTM levers (cashbacks, platform fees, partner payouts, incentives) interact with contribution margins is directly relevant to what this role deals with dailyExperience in a business where pricing, take rate, and market/category profitability are live decisions (not just budget exercises) is a strong fitGood to HaveFamiliarity with two-sided marketplace or unit-economics-driven business modelsExperience supporting investor-facing reporting or preparing materials for listed company disclosuresPrior experience in a startup or high-growth environment where finance is a commercial function, not just a control functionAt Urban Company we are committed to providing equal and fair opportunities in employment and creating an inclusive work environment. We endeavor to maintain a work environment free from harassment based on age, color, physical ability, marital status, parental status, ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation, or gender identity.
